import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static int n, t, sp, pp, rx, ry;
    static int[][] ir = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] sc = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] pc = new int[20][20];
    static char[][] s = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] p = new char[20][20];
    static int[][] dd = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] dx = {{0, 1, -1, 0}, {1, 0, 0, -1}};
    static int[][] dy = {{0, 1, -1, 0}, {1, 0, 0, -1}};
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] e = new ArrayList[2020];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] ns = new ArrayList[20][20];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] np = new ArrayList[20][20];
    static int[] ds = new int[2020];
    static int[] pa = new int[2020];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2020; i++) {
            e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                ns[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                np[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }

    public static void ade(int a, int b) {
        e[a].add(b);
        e[b].add(a);
    }

    public static boolean bfs() {
        ArrayDeque<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= sp; i++) {
            if (pa[i] == 0) {
                ds[i] = 0;
                q.add(i);
            } else {
                ds[i] = 3010;
            }
        }
        ds[0] = 3010;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            if (ds[u] < ds[0]) {
                for (int i = 0; i < e[u].size(); i++) {
                    int v = pa[e[u].get(i)];
                    if (ds[v] > ds[u] + 1) {
                        ds[v] = ds[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ds[0] != 3010;
    }

    public static boolean dfs(int x) {
        if (x == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < e[x].size(); i++) {
            int u = pa[e[x].get(i)];
            if (ds[u] == ds[x] + 1) {
                if (dfs(u)) {
                    pa[x] = e[x].get(i);
                    pa[e[x].get(i)] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static int hkp() {
        int an = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= sp; i++) {
                if (pa[i] == 0) {
                    an += dfs(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return an;
    }

    public static void wk(int a, int b) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                dd[i][j] = 100000;
            }
        }
        ArrayDeque<Pair> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        dd[a][b] = 0;
        q.add(new Pair(a, b));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll().first;
            int y = q.poll().second;
            for (int i = 0; i < np[x][y].size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < ns[a][b].size(); j++) {
                    ade(ns[a][b].get(j), np[x][y].get(i));
                }
            }
            if (dd[x][y] == ir[x][y]) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[0][d];
                int ny = y + dy[0][d];
                if (sc[nx][ny] != -1 && dd[nx][ny] > dd[x][y] + 1 && dd[x][y] + 1 <= ir[nx][ny]) {
                    dd[nx][ny] = dd[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new Pair(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                ir[i][j] = t;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            s[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            p[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        sp = 1;
        pp = 1000;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z' || s[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    sc[i][j] = -1;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if ('0' <= s[i][j] && s[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sc[i][j] = s[i][j] - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < sc[i][j]; k++) {
                    ns[i][j].add(sp++);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if ('0' <= p[i][j] && p[i][j] <= '9') {
                    pc[i][j] = p[i][j] - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < pc[i][j]; k++) {
                    np[i][j].add(pp++);
                }
            }
        }
        ArrayDeque<Pair> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(new Pair(rx, ry));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            rx = q.poll().first;
            ry = q.poll().second;
            int nx, ny;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                nx = rx + dx[0][d];
                ny = ry + dy[0][d];
                if (ir[nx][ny] > ir[rx][ry] + 1 && sc[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    ir[nx][ny] = ir[rx][ry] + 1;
                    q.add(new Pair(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sc[i][j] > 0) {
                    wk(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        pw.println(hkp());
        pw.close();
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first;
        int second;

        public Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }
}
